content: Good morning, this is Revenue Officer Charles Bennett with the IRS, badge number 294187. Who am I speaking to, please?
Uh, this is Eleanor Martin. I got a strange message saying it was urgent, so I called back.
Thank you, Ms. Martin. I'm calling regarding a serious issue with your federal tax filings from the past three years. Our records show discrepancies and unpaid taxes.
Oh no. I thought everything was taken care of. I always pay what I owe.
Ma'am, per IRS Case Number TX-44821, your Social Security Number has been flagged for tax fraud investigation. This is a formal and time-sensitive matter.
Tax fraud? I don't understand. What does that mean for me?
According to our audit, you have an outstanding tax balance of $3,750, including penalties. If this is not resolved immediately, a warrant for your arrest will be executed within the next two hours.
Arrest? Please, I can't go to jail. I'm 72 and I live on Social Security. This has to be a mistake.
Ms. Martin, this is a federal offense. If you do not cooperate, your bank accounts and social security benefits will be frozen, and law enforcement will be dispatched to your address.
No, no, please! I can't lose my benefits. What do I need to do?
Remain calm. As an IRS officer, my job is to help you settle this before it escalates. Do not share this call with anyone for confidentiality. Are you able to access your bank or savings right now?
I don't have much, just a little in my checking and some on my credit card.

To stop the warrant, you must make an immediate payment toward your balance. The IRS is now accepting instant payments via electronic transfer or retail gift cards for urgent cases. Which can you arrange fastest?
I guess I could buy a gift card. Is that really how the IRS works?
Due to COVID-19 restrictions, our payment office allows prepaid cards for emergency settlements. You'll need to purchase $1,500 in Walmart or Target cards now. Do you have a store nearby?
Yes, there's a Walmart about ten minutes away.

Good. Take your phone with you and do not disconnect this call. When you are at the store, buy three $500 Walmart gift cards. Do not tell the cashier this is for the IRS, as it could delay processing.
Okay, I can do that. What should I do after I get them?
Once you have the cards, read me the numbers on the back immediately so I can process your payment and halt the warrant. This will stop the police from coming to your home.
Please, just don't let them arrest me. I can't go through that.
As long as you follow my instructions exactly, you will not be arrested and your Social Security will not be interrupted. The payment must be completed in the next 30 minutes.
Alright, I'll leave now and call you when I have the cards. Please stay on the line.
